name: better-codex-context
description: Shadow context replacement for Codex CLI: long sessions stay fast and on goal. The conversation, a task card and an exact archive are restored after zero-model resets; sidecar compression keeps them compact in the background.

interface.shortDescription: Shadow context replacement: fast, focused long sessions
interface.longDescription: Keeps a shadow context next to Codex's window: every user request on a budgeted task card (goal, standing rules, tasks, lessons), the files in play, and an exact archive of every output. When the window gets heavy, Codex resets it without a model call and the shadow takes its place. Restores AGENTS.md rules beyond Codex's size limit and stops fix-and-retry loops. Plugin only; Codex itself is not modified.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read the task card, obey its standing constraints and update it once per turn.
